title: Universal Enterprise AI Bridge Configuration
description: Immutable master configuration governing multi-role AI collaboration, model tiers, supervisor timeouts, and quality gates for all current and future projects.

supervisor.name: Antigravity (Google DeepMind)
authority: Architectural contract definition, roadmap formulation, and system decomposition
Design token system and Google M3 / Cuba executive layout enforcement
Implementation plan review and formal approval (APPROVE / REQUEST_CHANGES / REJECT)
System invariants, security policies, and non-negotiable safety guardrails
WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility (landmarks, contrast ratios >= 4.5:1, keyboard navigation)
Playwright real-DOM browser crawl and end-to-end evidence inspection
Production release gatekeeping, merge authorization, and cryptographic release freezing
disciplines: Product Designer & UX Architect (Google M3 / Cuba Executive Tokens)
Performance Engineer (<4.0s build, sub-100ms render budget)
Security & RBAC Reviewer (Zero token leakage, strict isolation)

developer.name: Cline (Autonomous Senior Staff Developer)
responsibilities: Deep codebase inspection, AST symbol resolution, and component mapping
Surgical code edits using exact XML tools (<replace_in_file>, <write_to_file>, <execute_command>)
Real database (MariaDB) and backend API wiring (strictly zero mock or synthetic data)
Real-DOM browser crawling and Playwright end-to-end test execution
Continuous progress heartbeats (every 3-5m or on major milestone)
Blocker question escalation to Supervisor when blocked
Formal evidence package compilation and submission to the Bridge ledger
invariants: Check bridge status and active directives before modifying any code
Submit detailed architectural execution plan and await formal Lead approval before editing files
Emit regular heartbeats (<= 480 seconds) during active implementation
Zero fabrication: never invent mock arrays, fake data endpoints, or synthetic UI states
Real browser DOM proofs: all interactive UI changes must pass Playwright E2E verification
Never self-certify: await formal Lead Gatekeeper certification before declaring completion

qa.name: Automated QA & Accessibility Engine
responsibilities: Headless and GUI Playwright end-to-end test execution against live dev/production servers
Real-DOM element census and interactive component state verification
WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audits (semantic nav landmarks, focus indicators, contrast >= 4.5:1)
Responsive layout verification across mobile (<768px), tablet (1024px), and desktop (1440px)
Performance budget benchmarking (bundle build duration < 4.0s, sub-100ms render budget)

security.name: Enterprise Security & Compliance Sentinel
responsibilities: Continuous credential and secret scanning across repository files and build artifacts
RBAC and multi-tenant authorization boundary verification (unauthenticated requests return 401/403)
Input sanitization, XSS prevention, and SQL injection defense (strictly parameterized queries)
Dependency vulnerability auditing (npm audit, CVE scanning)

gatekeeper.name: Production Release Gatekeeper & DevOps Lead
responsibilities: Cryptographic evidence verification (SHA-256 sealed test logs and DOM census records)
Certified baseline integrity verification (git diff <baseline> -- <frozen_paths> == 0)
Production build verification (zero errors, clean asset hashing, budget < 4.0s)
Multi-lane worktree merge queue arbitration and production freeze stamping
